scientific_integrity: The proof supplies a boundary-priority formula, local pair-dependence classification, dependency-graph Poisson bounds and tail truncation. Independent exact finite enumeration is supporting evidence, not an asymptotic proof.
scientific_limitations: Two independent uniformly inserted binary search trees on the same ordered keys; shared sets of consecutive keys, not shape isomorphisms. Historical priority is qualified; independent audit not performed.
title: A Fréchet law for the largest shared key interval in independent random binary search trees
